description.en:
Meant to move a match player to a position during a scripted match event, but it does nothing in this build.
The native checks for 3 arguments, reads the position array (argument 2) and the integer (argument 3), never even reads the handle, and returns true without moving anything. It is never called by the shipped scripts. Use CMND_BTL_SET_CHARA_POS to place a match player instead.
Counted in the argument check but never read.
3-element array [x, y, z]. Read, then ignored.

Always true when 3 or more arguments are given (this only means the arguments were accepted).
null if the match system is not ready or fewer than 3 arguments were given.

examples.case: Use CMND_BTL_SET_CHARA_POS instead (not found in script_clean/; invented)
